
## 3. Give the app a clean structure

The template keeps everything in `Program.cs`. We will move the setup into small files so `Program.cs` stays readable. Create these folders:

```text
ForgetMeNot/
  Data/
  Endpoints/
  Infrastructure/
```

The final `Program.cs` is only a few lines:

```csharp
using ForgetMeNot;
using ForgetMeNot.Endpoints;
using ForgetMeNot.Infrastructure;

var builder = WebApplication.CreateBuilder(args);
builder.AddForgetMeNot();

var app = builder.Build();
app.UseForgetMeNot();
app.MapForgetMeNot();

app.Run();
```

Each extension does one job:

| File | Responsibility |
|---|---|
| `Infrastructure/ForgetMeNotSetup.cs` | The one `AddForgetMeNot()` and `UseForgetMeNot()` entry point |
| `Infrastructure/DataSetup.cs` | EF Core and SQLite |
| `Infrastructure/SessionAuthSetup.cs` | Session, antiforgery and password hashing |
| `Infrastructure/InertiaSetup.cs` | Inertia options, shared props and SSR |
| `Infrastructure/SessionAuth.cs` | Sign in/out helpers and the `RequireSessionUser` filter |
| `Endpoints/AuthEndpoints.cs` | Register, login and logout |
| `Endpoints/TodoEndpoints.cs` | Private lists and items |
| `Endpoints/PublicEndpoints.cs` | The public share page |

A beginner can read `Program.cs` in one glance. That is the point.

The route table is also one readable file:

```csharp
// Endpoints/ForgetMeNotEndpoints.cs
public static class ForgetMeNotEndpoints
{
    public static IEndpointRouteBuilder MapForgetMeNot(this IEndpointRouteBuilder app)
    {
        app.MapGet("/health", () => Results.Ok("ok"));
        app.MapGet("/", () => Render("Home"));
        app.MapGet("/login", () => Render("Auth/Login"));
        app.MapGet("/register", () => Render("Auth/Register"));

        app.MapAuthEndpoints();
        app.MapTodoEndpoints();
        app.MapPublicEndpoints();
        return app;
    }
}
```

If a route is hard to find, start there.

## 4. Model the data

Add the entities:

```csharp
// Data/Entities.cs
public sealed class AppUser
{
    public int Id { get; set; }
    public required string Email { get; set; }
    public required string DisplayName { get; set; }
    public required string PasswordHash { get; set; }
    public List<TodoList> Lists { get; } = [];
}

public sealed class TodoList
{
    public int Id { get; set; }
    public int UserId { get; set; }
    public AppUser User { get; set; } = null!;
    public required string Title { get; set; }
    public required string PublicSlug { get; set; }
    public bool IsPublic { get; set; }
    public List<TodoItem> Items { get; } = [];
}

public sealed class TodoItem
{
    public int Id { get; set; }
    public int TodoListId { get; set; }
    public TodoList List { get; set; } = null!;
    public required string Title { get; set; }
    public bool IsDone { get; set; }
    public DateTimeOffset? DueAt { get; set; }
    public DateTimeOffset? RemindAt { get; set; }
    public DateTimeOffset? RemindedAt { get; set; }
}
```

`PublicSlug` is the secret part of a public URL. `RemindedAt` makes reminder delivery idempotent: if the worker restarts, it does not send the same reminder again.

```csharp
// Data/AppDbContext.cs
public sealed class AppDbContext(DbContextOptions<AppDbContext> options) : DbContext(options)
{
    public DbSet<AppUser> Users => Set<AppUser>();
    public DbSet<TodoList> Lists => Set<TodoList>();
    public DbSet<TodoItem> Items => Set<TodoItem>();

    protected override void OnModelCreating(ModelBuilder model)
    {
        model.Entity<TodoList>().HasIndex(l => l.PublicSlug).IsUnique();
        model.Entity<TodoItem>().HasIndex(i => new { i.TodoListId, i.RemindAt, i.RemindedAt });
    }
}
```

```csharp
// Data/PageModels.cs
public sealed record TodoListDto(int Id, string Title, string PublicSlug, bool IsPublic, int Total, int Open);
public sealed record TodoItemDto(int Id, string Title, bool IsDone, DateTimeOffset? DueAt);
public sealed record TodoListHeader(int Id, string Title, string PublicSlug, bool IsPublic);
public sealed record ReminderDto(int Id, string Title, DateTimeOffset RemindAt);
public sealed record TodoStats(int Open, int Done, int DueToday);
public sealed record PublicListHeader(int Id, string Title, string Owner, int OpenCount);
public sealed record PublicTodoDto(int Id, string Title, DateTimeOffset? DueAt);
public sealed record TodoItemsPage(List<TodoItemDto> Data);
public sealed record PublicTodoPage(List<PublicTodoDto> Data);

public sealed class CreateListForm
{
    [Required, MaxLength(120)]
    public string? Title { get; set; }

    public bool IsPublic { get; set; }
}

public sealed class CreateTodoForm
{
    [Required, MaxLength(200)]
    public string? Title { get; set; }

    public DateTimeOffset? DueAt { get; set; }
    public DateTimeOffset? RemindAt { get; set; }
}
```

The template uses source-generated JSON. Add every prop and form type to its `AppJsonContext`:

```csharp
[JsonSourceGenerationOptions(JsonSerializerDefaults.Web)]
[JsonSerializable(typeof(AuthUser))]
[JsonSerializable(typeof(SharedProps))]
[JsonSerializable(typeof(Flash))]
[JsonSerializable(typeof(TodoListDto))]
[JsonSerializable(typeof(List<TodoListDto>))]
[JsonSerializable(typeof(TodoItemDto))]
[JsonSerializable(typeof(TodoListHeader))]
[JsonSerializable(typeof(TodoItemsPage))]
[JsonSerializable(typeof(ReminderDto))]
[JsonSerializable(typeof(List<ReminderDto>))]
[JsonSerializable(typeof(TodoStats))]
[JsonSerializable(typeof(PublicListHeader))]
[JsonSerializable(typeof(PublicTodoDto))]
[JsonSerializable(typeof(PublicTodoPage))]
[JsonSerializable(typeof(RegisterForm))]
[JsonSerializable(typeof(LoginForm))]
[JsonSerializable(typeof(CreateListForm))]
[JsonSerializable(typeof(CreateTodoForm))]
internal sealed partial class AppJsonContext : JsonSerializerContext;
```

The data setup extension:

```csharp
// Infrastructure/DataSetup.cs
public static class DataSetup
{
    public static WebApplicationBuilder AddForgetMeNotData(this WebApplicationBuilder builder)
    {
        builder.Services.AddDbContext<AppDbContext>(o =>
            o.UseSqlite("Data Source=forgetmenot.db"));
        return builder;
    }

    public static WebApplication EnsureForgetMeNotData(this WebApplication app)
    {
        using var scope = app.Services.CreateScope();
        scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<AppDbContext>().Database.EnsureCreated();
        return app;
    }
}
```

`EnsureCreated()` is perfect for a first app. For production, replace it with EF migrations.

## 5. Use sessions for sign-in

Sessions keep the signed-in user id and Inertia's flash/error state on the server. The browser only holds an HttpOnly session cookie.

```csharp
// Infrastructure/SessionAuthSetup.cs
public static class SessionAuthSetup
{
    public static WebApplicationBuilder AddForgetMeNotSessionAuth(this WebApplicationBuilder builder)
    {
        builder.Services.AddDistributedMemoryCache();
        builder.Services.AddSession(o =>
        {
            o.Cookie.Name = ".fmn.session";
            o.Cookie.HttpOnly = true;
            o.Cookie.IsEssential = true;
            o.Cookie.SameSite = SameSiteMode.Lax;
            o.Cookie.SecurePolicy = builder.Environment.IsDevelopment()
                ? CookieSecurePolicy.SameAsRequest
                : CookieSecurePolicy.Always;
            o.IdleTimeout = TimeSpan.FromDays(7);
        });

        builder.Services.AddAntiforgery(o => o.HeaderName = InertiaHeaders.XsrfToken);
        builder.Services.AddScoped<IPasswordHasher<AppUser>, PasswordHasher<AppUser>>();
        return builder;
    }

    public static WebApplication UseForgetMeNotSession(this WebApplication app)
    {
        app.UseSession();
        return app;
    }
}
```

The session helpers and the endpoint filter:

```csharp
// Infrastructure/SessionAuth.cs
public static class SessionAuth
{
    public const string UserIdKey = "fmn.user-id";
    public const string DisplayNameKey = "fmn.display-name";

    public static int? UserId(this HttpContext http) => http.Session.GetInt32(UserIdKey);

    public static void SignIn(this HttpContext http, AppUser user)
    {
        http.Session.SetInt32(UserIdKey, user.Id);
        http.Session.SetString(DisplayNameKey, user.DisplayName);
    }

    public static void SignOut(this HttpContext http) => http.Session.Clear();
}

public sealed class RequireSessionUser : IEndpointFilter
{
    public async ValueTask<object?> InvokeAsync(
        EndpointFilterInvocationContext context,
        EndpointFilterDelegate next)
    {
        if (context.HttpContext.UserId() is null)
        {
            return Inertia.Net.Inertia.Location("/login");
        }

        return await next(context);
    }
}
```

<Callout type="warning" title="One instance for this sample">
`AddDistributedMemoryCache()` keeps sessions in memory. That is fine for one app instance. For more than one replica, register a shared cache such as Redis, or the session will only exist on the instance that created it.
</Callout>

## 6. Hide the Inertia setup

`InertiaSetup.cs` is the only file a beginner needs to know when they want to change Inertia behavior.

```csharp
// Infrastructure/InertiaSetup.cs
public static class InertiaSetup
{
    public static WebApplicationBuilder AddForgetMeNotInertia(this WebApplicationBuilder builder)
    {
        builder.Services.AddInertia(o =>
        {
            o.Share("appName", "ForgetMeNot");
            o.Share("auth", ctx =>
            {
                var id = ctx.Session.GetInt32(SessionAuth.UserIdKey);
                var name = ctx.Session.GetString(SessionAuth.DisplayNameKey);
                return id is null ? null : new AuthUser(id.Value, name ?? "You");
            });
            o.Share("baseUrl", ctx =>
                $"{ctx.Request.Scheme}://{ctx.Request.Host}{ctx.Request.PathBase}");

            o.Pages.Directory = "ClientApp/pages";
            o.Vite.Prefetch = VitePrefetch.Waterfall;
            o.State.UseSession();                  // flash/errors live in the session too
            o.TypeScript.OutputPath = "ClientApp/types/inertia.d.ts";
            o.TypeScript.SharedProps<SharedProps>().FlashData<Flash>();
            o.Ssr.BundlePath = "ssr/ssr.js";
            o.Ssr.Mode = SsrMode.Preferred;
            o.Ssr.UseNodeProcess(n => n.Executable = "bun");
        });

        builder.Services.AddInertiaDevTools();
        return builder;
    }

    public static WebApplication UseForgetMeNotInertia(this WebApplication app)
    {
        app.UseInertia();
        app.UseInertiaAntiforgery();
        return app;
    }
}

public sealed record AuthUser(int Id, string DisplayName);
public sealed record SharedProps(string AppName, AuthUser? Auth, string BaseUrl);
public sealed record Flash(string? Success);
```

Now the aggregate setup:

```csharp
// Infrastructure/ForgetMeNotSetup.cs
public static class ForgetMeNotSetup
{
    public static WebApplicationBuilder AddForgetMeNot(this WebApplicationBuilder builder)
    {
        builder.Services.Configure<ForwardedHeadersOptions>(o =>
        {
            o.ForwardedHeaders = ForwardedHeaders.XForwardedFor | ForwardedHeaders.XForwardedProto;
            o.ForwardLimit = 1;
            o.KnownIPNetworks.Clear();
            o.KnownProxies.Clear();
        });

        builder.Services.AddValidation();
        builder.Services.AddProblemDetails();
        builder.Services.AddResponseCompression(o => o.EnableForHttps = true);
        builder.Services.ConfigureHttpJsonOptions(o =>
            o.SerializerOptions.TypeInfoResolverChain.Insert(0, AppJsonContext.Default));

        builder.AddForgetMeNotData();
        builder.AddForgetMeNotSessionAuth();
        builder.AddForgetMeNotInertia();
        return builder;
    }

    public static WebApplication UseForgetMeNot(this WebApplication app)
    {
        app.UseForwardedHeaders();
        app.UseResponseCompression();
        app.UseStaticFiles(new StaticFileOptions
        {
            OnPrepareResponse = c =>
            {
                if (c.Context.Request.Path.StartsWithSegments("/build/assets"))
                    c.Context.Response.Headers.CacheControl = "public, max-age=31536000, immutable";
            },
        });

        app.UseForgetMeNotSession();
        app.UseForgetMeNotInertia();
        app.EnsureForgetMeNotData();
        return app;
    }
}
```

`UseSession()` must run before `UseInertia()`. Add forwarded-header configuration if you deploy behind Coolify or another TLS proxy.

## 7. Register, sign in and sign out

The endpoints live in `Endpoints/AuthEndpoints.cs` and are mapped from `MapForgetMeNot()`. `WithInertiaValidation()` turns model errors into a redirect back with `errors`.

```csharp
public sealed class RegisterForm
{
    [Required, EmailAddress]
    public string? Email { get; set; }

    [Required, MinLength(8)]
    public string? Password { get; set; }

    [Required, MaxLength(80)]
    public string? DisplayName { get; set; }
}

public sealed class LoginForm
{
    [Required, EmailAddress]
    public string? Email { get; set; }

    [Required]
    public string? Password { get; set; }
}

public static class AuthEndpoints
{
    public static IEndpointRouteBuilder MapAuthEndpoints(this IEndpointRouteBuilder app)
    {
        app.MapPost("/register", async (
            RegisterForm form, AppDbContext db, IPasswordHasher<AppUser> hasher, HttpContext http) =>
        {
            var email = form.Email!.Trim().ToLowerInvariant();
            if (await db.Users.AnyAsync(u => u.Email == email))
            {
                return Back().WithErrors(new Dictionary<string, string>
                {
                    ["email"] = "An account with this email already exists.",
                });
            }

            var user = new AppUser
            {
                Email = email,
                DisplayName = form.DisplayName!.Trim(),
                PasswordHash = "",
            };
            user.PasswordHash = hasher.HashPassword(user, form.Password!);

            db.Users.Add(user);
            await db.SaveChangesAsync();

            http.Inertia().Flash("success", "Account created. Sign in to continue.");
            return Results.Redirect("/login");
        }).WithInertiaValidation();

        app.MapPost("/login", async (
            LoginForm form, AppDbContext db, IPasswordHasher<AppUser> hasher, HttpContext http) =>
        {
            var email = form.Email!.Trim().ToLowerInvariant();
            var user = await db.Users.SingleOrDefaultAsync(u => u.Email == email);

            if (user is null || hasher.VerifyHashedPassword(user, user.PasswordHash, form.Password!)
                == PasswordVerificationResult.Failed)
            {
                return Back().WithErrors(new Dictionary<string, string>
                {
                    ["email"] = "These credentials do not match our records.",
                });
            }

            http.SignIn(user);
            return Results.Redirect("/todos");
        }).WithInertiaValidation();

        app.MapPost("/logout", (HttpContext http) =>
        {
            http.SignOut();
            http.Inertia().ClearHistory();
            return Results.Redirect("/");
        });

        return app;
    }
}
```

The login page uses `useForm` and shadcn components:

```tsx
// ClientApp/pages/Auth/Login.tsx
import { Link, useForm } from '@inertiajs/react'
import type { FormEvent } from 'react'
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button'
import { Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardHeader, CardTitle } from '@/components/ui/card'
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input'
import { Label } from '@/components/ui/label'
import Layout from '../../Layout'

export default function Login() {
  const form = useForm({ email: '', password: '' })

  const submit = (event: FormEvent) => {
    event.preventDefault()
    form.post('/login', { onFinish: () => form.reset('password') })
  }

  return (
    <Layout>
      <Card className="mx-auto mt-12 max-w-md">
        <CardHeader>
          <CardTitle>Welcome back</CardTitle>
          <CardDescription>Sign in to see your lists and reminders.</CardDescription>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent>
          <form onSubmit={submit} className="space-y-4">
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label htmlFor="email">Email</Label>
              <Input id="email" type="email" value={form.data.email} onChange={(e) => form.setData('email', e.target.value)} />
              {form.errors.email && <p className="text-sm text-red-600">{form.errors.email}</p>}
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label htmlFor="password">Password</Label>
              <Input id="password" type="password" value={form.data.password} onChange={(e) => form.setData('password', e.target.value)} />
              {form.errors.password && <p className="text-sm text-red-600">{form.errors.password}</p>}
            </div>

            <Button type="submit" className="w-full" disabled={form.processing}>
              {form.processing ? 'Signing in...' : 'Sign in'}
            </Button>

            <p className="text-center text-sm text-muted-foreground">
              New here? <Link href="/register" className="font-medium text-foreground underline">Create an account</Link>
            </p>
          </form>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
    </Layout>
  )
}
```

The register page is the same pattern with `displayName`, `email` and `password`.

<Callout type="tip" title="Checkpoint">
Create an account, sign in, refresh the page and confirm you stay signed in. Sign out and confirm you return to the home page. If the session cookie is not sent, check that `UseForgetMeNotSession()` runs before `UseForgetMeNotInertia()`.
</Callout>

## 8. Build the dashboard

Map the private endpoints from `TodoEndpoints.cs`:

```csharp
public static class TodoEndpoints
{
    public static IEndpointRouteBuilder MapTodoEndpoints(this IEndpointRouteBuilder app)
    {
        app.MapGet("/todos", async (HttpContext http, AppDbContext db, CancellationToken ct) =>
        {
            var userId = http.UserId()!.Value;

            var lists = await db.Lists
                .AsNoTracking()
                .Where(l => l.UserId == userId)
                .OrderBy(l => l.Title)
                .Select(l => new TodoListDto(
                    l.Id, l.Title, l.PublicSlug, l.IsPublic,
                    l.Items.Count, l.Items.Count(i => !i.IsDone)))
                .ToListAsync(ct);

            return Render("Todos/Index", new InertiaProps
            {
                ["lists"] = lists,
                ["reminders"] = Defer(ct => LoadReminders(db, userId, ct), group: "sidebar"),
                ["stats"] = Defer(ct => LoadStats(db, userId, ct), group: "sidebar"),
            });
        }).AddEndpointFilter<RequireSessionUser>();

        // ...the list, create and toggle endpoints below...
        return app;
    }
}
```

Create a list from the dashboard:

```csharp
app.MapPost("/lists", async (
    CreateListForm form, HttpContext http, AppDbContext db, CancellationToken ct) =>
{
    var list = new TodoList
    {
        UserId = http.UserId()!.Value,
        Title = form.Title!.Trim(),
        IsPublic = form.IsPublic,
        PublicSlug = NewPublicSlug(),
    };
    db.Lists.Add(list);
    await db.SaveChangesAsync(ct);
    return Results.Redirect($"/todos/{list.Id}");
}).AddEndpointFilter<RequireSessionUser>().WithInertiaValidation();

static string NewPublicSlug() =>
    Convert.ToHexString(RandomNumberGenerator.GetBytes(8)).ToLowerInvariant();
```

The two deferred loaders:

```csharp
static async Task<List<ReminderDto>> LoadReminders(AppDbContext db, int userId, CancellationToken ct) =>
    await db.Items
        .AsNoTracking()
        .Where(i => i.List.UserId == userId && i.RemindAt != null && i.RemindedAt == null)
        .OrderBy(i => i.RemindAt)
        .Take(10)
        .Select(i => new ReminderDto(i.Id, i.Title, i.RemindAt!.Value))
        .ToListAsync(ct);

static async Task<TodoStats> LoadStats(AppDbContext db, int userId, CancellationToken ct)
{
    var today = DateTimeOffset.UtcNow.Date;
    return new TodoStats(
        await db.Items.CountAsync(i => i.List.UserId == userId && !i.IsDone, ct),
        await db.Items.CountAsync(i => i.List.UserId == userId && i.IsDone, ct),
        await db.Items.CountAsync(i => i.List.UserId == userId && !i.IsDone
            && i.DueAt != null && i.DueAt < today.AddDays(1), ct));
}
```

The dashboard React page uses `Card`, `Badge` and `Deferred`:

```tsx
// ClientApp/pages/Todos/Index.tsx
import { Deferred, Link, useForm } from '@inertiajs/react'
import { Plus } from 'lucide-react'
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge'
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button'
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle } from '@/components/ui/card'
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input'
import Layout from '../../Layout'

interface Props {
  lists: { id: number; title: string; isPublic: boolean; total: number; open: number }[]
  reminders?: { id: number; title: string; remindAt: string }[]
  stats?: { open: number; done: number; dueToday: number }
}

export default function Index({ lists, reminders, stats }: Props) {
  const form = useForm({ title: '' })

  return (
    <Layout>
      <div className="flex items-end justify-between gap-4">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-3xl font-semibold tracking-tight">Your lists</h1>
          <p className="mt-1 text-muted-foreground">Private by default. Share a list when you want to.</p>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="mt-8 grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2">
        {lists.map((list) => (
          <Link key={list.id} href={`/todos/${list.id}`}>
            <Card className="transition-colors hover:border-primary/40">
              <CardHeader>
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
                  <CardTitle>{list.title}</CardTitle>
                  <Badge variant={list.isPublic ? 'default' : 'secondary'}>{list.isPublic ? 'Public' : 'Private'}</Badge>
                </div>
              </CardHeader>
              <CardContent className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                {list.open} open of {list.total}
              </CardContent>
            </Card>
          </Link>
        ))}
      </div>

      <Card className="mt-8">
        <CardHeader><CardTitle>New list</CardTitle></CardHeader>
        <CardContent>
          <form onSubmit={(event) => { event.preventDefault(); form.post('/lists', { onSuccess: () => form.reset() }) }} className="flex gap-2">
            <Input value={form.data.title} onChange={(e) => form.setData('title', e.target.value)} placeholder="Weekend plans" />
            <Button type="submit" disabled={form.processing}><Plus className="size-4" /> Add</Button>
          </form>
          {form.errors.title && <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-red-600">{form.errors.title}</p>}
        </CardContent>
      </Card>

      <div className="mt-8 grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2">
        <Deferred data="stats" fallback={<p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Counting...</p>}>
          <Card>
            <CardHeader><CardTitle>Overview</CardTitle></CardHeader>
            <CardContent className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
              {stats?.open} open · {stats?.done} done · {stats?.dueToday} due today
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </Deferred>

        <Deferred data="reminders" fallback={<p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Loading reminders...</p>}>
          <Card>
            <CardHeader><CardTitle>Upcoming reminders</CardTitle></CardHeader>
            <CardContent>
              {reminders?.length ? reminders.map((reminder) => (
                <p key={reminder.id} className="text-sm">{reminder.title}</p>
              )) : <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Nothing scheduled.</p>}
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </Deferred>
      </div>
    </Layout>
  )
}
```

## 9. Load items in pages

These snippets live inside `MapTodoEndpoints` in `Endpoints/TodoEndpoints.cs`.

Add the list endpoint with `Scroll`:

```csharp
app.MapGet("/todos/{id:int}", async (
    int id, int? page, HttpContext http, AppDbContext db, CancellationToken ct) =>
{
    var userId = http.UserId()!.Value;
    var list = await db.Lists
        .AsNoTracking()
        .Where(l => l.Id == id && l.UserId == userId)
        .Select(l => new TodoListHeader(l.Id, l.Title, l.PublicSlug, l.IsPublic))
        .FirstOrDefaultAsync(ct);

    if (list is null) return Results.NotFound();

    const int pageSize = 40;
    var current = Math.Max(1, page ?? 1);
    var rows = await db.Items
        .AsNoTracking()
        .Where(i => i.TodoListId == id)
        .OrderBy(i => i.IsDone)
        .ThenBy(i => i.DueAt)
        .ThenBy(i => i.Id)
        .Skip((current - 1) * pageSize)
        .Take(pageSize + 1)
        .Select(i => new TodoItemDto(i.Id, i.Title, i.IsDone, i.DueAt))
        .ToListAsync(ct);

    return Render("Todos/Show", new InertiaProps
    {
        ["list"] = list,
        ["items"] = Scroll(
            new TodoItemsPage(rows.Take(pageSize).ToList()),
            metadata: ScrollMetadata.FromPage(current, rows.Count > pageSize)),
    });
}).AddEndpointFilter<RequireSessionUser>();
```

The React page asks for the next page as the user scrolls:

Add the write endpoints:

```csharp
app.MapPost("/todos/{id:int}/items", async (
    int id, CreateTodoForm form, HttpContext http, AppDbContext db, CancellationToken ct) =>
{
    var userId = http.UserId()!.Value;
    if (!await db.Lists.AnyAsync(l => l.Id == id && l.UserId == userId, ct))
        return Results.NotFound();

    db.Items.Add(new TodoItem
    {
        TodoListId = id,
        Title = form.Title!.Trim(),
        DueAt = form.DueAt,
        RemindAt = form.RemindAt,
    });
    await db.SaveChangesAsync(ct);

    return Back().WithFlash("success", "Todo added");
}).AddEndpointFilter<RequireSessionUser>().WithInertiaValidation();

app.MapPatch("/items/{id:int}", async (
    int id, HttpContext http, AppDbContext db, CancellationToken ct) =>
{
    var userId = http.UserId()!.Value;
    var item = await db.Items
        .Include(i => i.List)
        .FirstOrDefaultAsync(i => i.Id == id && i.List.UserId == userId, ct);

    if (item is null) return Results.NotFound();

    item.IsDone = !item.IsDone;
    await db.SaveChangesAsync(ct);
    return Back();
}).AddEndpointFilter<RequireSessionUser>();
```

The React page asks for the next page as the user scrolls:

```tsx
// ClientApp/pages/Todos/Show.tsx
import { InfiniteScroll, router, useForm } from '@inertiajs/react'
import type { FormEvent } from 'react'
import { Checkbox } from '@/components/ui/checkbox'
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button'
import { Card, CardContent } from '@/components/ui/card'
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input'
import Layout from '../../Layout'

interface Props {
  list: { id: number; title: string }
  items: { data: { id: number; title: string; isDone: boolean; dueAt: string | null }[] }
}

export default function Show({ list, items }: Props) {
  const form = useForm({ title: '', dueAt: '', remindAt: '' })

  const submit = (event: FormEvent) => {
    event.preventDefault()
    form.post(`/todos/${list.id}/items`, { onSuccess: () => form.reset() })
  }

  return (
    <Layout>
      <h1 className="text-3xl font-semibold tracking-tight">{list.title}</h1>
      <p className="mt-1 text-muted-foreground">Loaded in pages, merged as you scroll.</p>

      <Card className="mt-6">
        <CardContent className="p-4">
          <form onSubmit={submit} className="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-[1fr_auto_auto_auto]">
            <Input placeholder="What needs doing?" value={form.data.title} onChange={(e) => form.setData('title', e.target.value)} />
            <Input type="datetime-local" value={form.data.dueAt} onChange={(e) => form.setData('dueAt', e.target.value)} aria-label="Due date" />
            <Input type="datetime-local" value={form.data.remindAt} onChange={(e) => form.setData('remindAt', e.target.value)} aria-label="Remind me" />
            <Button type="submit" disabled={form.processing}>Add</Button>
          </form>
          {form.errors.title && <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-red-600">{form.errors.title}</p>}
        </CardContent>
      </Card>

      <InfiniteScroll data="items" className="mt-8 space-y-3">
        {items.data.map((item) => (
          <Card key={item.id}>
            <CardContent className="flex items-center gap-3 p-4">
              <Checkbox checked={item.isDone} onCheckedChange={() => router.patch(`/items/${item.id}`)} />
              <span className={item.isDone ? 'text-muted-foreground line-through' : ''}>{item.title}</span>
              {item.dueAt && <span className="ml-auto text-xs text-muted-foreground">{new Date(item.dueAt).toLocaleDateString()}</span>}
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        ))}
      </InfiniteScroll>
    </Layout>
  )
}
```

`Scroll` merges the `data` array and tells `InfiniteScroll` which URL parameter to use. The browser only renders the pages it has requested.

<Callout type="tip" title="Checkpoint">
Create a list, add more than one page of items, then scroll. The network panel should show a partial reload for each new page, and existing items should remain in place.
</Callout>

## 10. Share a list publicly

Public routes do not use `RequireSessionUser`. Use a random slug, not the numeric id, and return a small DTO instead of the entity.

```csharp
app.MapGet("/p/{slug}", async (
    string slug, int? page, AppDbContext db, CancellationToken ct) =>
{
    var list = await db.Lists
        .AsNoTracking()
        .Where(l => l.PublicSlug == slug && l.IsPublic)
        .Select(l => new PublicListHeader(l.Id, l.Title, l.User.DisplayName, l.Items.Count(i => !i.IsDone)))
        .FirstOrDefaultAsync(ct);

    if (list is null) return Results.NotFound();

    const int pageSize = 25;
    var current = Math.Max(1, page ?? 1);
    var rows = await db.Items
        .AsNoTracking()
        .Where(i => i.TodoListId == list.Id && !i.IsDone)
        .OrderBy(i => i.DueAt)
        .ThenBy(i => i.Id)
        .Skip((current - 1) * pageSize)
        .Take(pageSize + 1)
        .Select(i => new PublicTodoDto(i.Id, i.Title, i.DueAt))
        .ToListAsync(ct);

    return Render("Public/Show", new InertiaProps
    {
        ["list"] = list,
        ["items"] = Scroll(
            new PublicTodoPage(rows.Take(pageSize).ToList()),
            metadata: ScrollMetadata.FromPage(current, rows.Count > pageSize)),
    });
});
```

The handler above is the body of `PublicEndpoints.MapPublicEndpoints` in `Endpoints/PublicEndpoints.cs`.

```csharp
static string NewPublicSlug() =>
    Convert.ToHexString(RandomNumberGenerator.GetBytes(8)).ToLowerInvariant();
```

The public page is the same `InfiniteScroll` pattern, wrapped in a clean card:

```tsx
// ClientApp/pages/Public/Show.tsx
import { InfiniteScroll } from '@inertiajs/react'
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge'
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle } from '@/components/ui/card'
import Layout from '../../Layout'

interface Props {
  list: { title: string; owner: string; openCount: number }
  items: { data: { id: number; title: string; dueAt: string | null }[] }
}

export default function PublicShow({ list, items }: Props) {
  return (
    <Layout>
      <Badge variant="secondary">Public list</Badge>
      <h1 className="mt-4 text-4xl font-semibold tracking-tight">{list.title}</h1>
      <p className="mt-2 text-muted-foreground">Shared by {list.owner} · {list.openCount} open items</p>

      <InfiniteScroll data="items" className="mt-8 space-y-3">
        {items.data.map((item) => (
          <Card key={item.id}>
            <CardHeader><CardTitle className="text-base">{item.title}</CardTitle></CardHeader>
            {item.dueAt && <CardContent className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Due {new Date(item.dueAt).toLocaleDateString()}</CardContent>}
          </Card>
        ))}
      </InfiniteScroll>
    </Layout>
  )
}
```

Put the `/p/{slug}` handler in `Endpoints/PublicEndpoints.cs` inside `MapPublicEndpoints`, then add it to the route table. Open the URL in a private browser window to prove no session is needed.

<Callout type="warning" title="Do not leak the private shape">
Return `PublicTodoDto`, not `TodoItem`. Public pages must not include `RemindAt`, the owner's email or private lists.
</Callout>

## 11. Send reminders once

A background service checks for due items every minute, sends them, and records `RemindedAt`.

```csharp
public interface IEmailSender
{
    Task SendAsync(string to, string subject, string body, CancellationToken ct = default);
}

public sealed class ReminderWorker(
    IServiceScopeFactory scopes,
    ILogger<ReminderWorker> logger) : BackgroundService
{
    protected override async Task ExecuteAsync(CancellationToken stoppingToken)
    {
        using var timer = new PeriodicTimer(TimeSpan.FromMinutes(1));

        while (await timer.WaitForNextTickAsync(stoppingToken))
        {
            using var scope = scopes.CreateScope();
            var db = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<AppDbContext>();
            var mail = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<IEmailSender>();
            var now = DateTimeOffset.UtcNow;

            var due = await db.Items
                .Include(i => i.List).ThenInclude(l => l.User)
                .Where(i => i.RemindAt != null && i.RemindAt <= now && i.RemindedAt == null)
                .OrderBy(i => i.RemindAt)
                .Take(100)
                .ToListAsync(stoppingToken);

            foreach (var item in due)
            {
                await mail.SendAsync(item.List.User.Email, $"Reminder: {item.Title}", item.Title, stoppingToken);
                item.RemindedAt = now;
            }

            if (due.Count > 0)
            {
                await db.SaveChangesAsync(stoppingToken);
                logger.LogInformation("Sent {Count} reminders", due.Count);
            }
        }
    }
}
```

Register the service in `ForgetMeNotSetup`:

```csharp
builder.Services.AddScoped<IEmailSender, SmtpEmailSender>(); // your implementation
builder.Services.AddHostedService<ReminderWorker>();
```

For a single instance, the timer is enough. For several instances, use a durable queue with leases (TickerQ, Hangfire or a database outbox) so only one worker claims each reminder.

## 12. Test the important paths

Add `public partial class Program;` to the app, then use `Inertia.Net.Testing`:

```csharp
var page = await client.GetInertiaPageAsync("/todos");

new AssertableInertia(page)
    .Component("Todos/Index")
    .Has("lists")
    .Missing("reminders");

var loaded = await page.LoadDeferredPropsAsync(client, "sidebar");
new AssertableInertia(loaded).Has("reminders");
```

For the public route, sign out first and assert that `remindAt` and the owner's email are absent. This is the test that protects you from accidentally returning the entity.

## 13. Run it in production

Build both bundles with Bun:

```sh
bun run build
dotnet publish -c Release
```

ForgetMeNot starts `ssr/ssr.js` with Bun. The container pattern is in the docs app and the published samples:

- `Dockerfile` from `docs/Inertia.Net.Docs`
- `samples/Inkwell/Dockerfile` for a single app with SQLite and Bun SSR
- `samples/CarParker/Dockerfile` for a Mongo-backed app with public pages
- `samples/TechLandierDistributed/Dockerfile` for a separate SSR pool

Read [Server-side rendering](/docs/server-side-rendering) and [Deploying behind a proxy](/docs/deploying) before exposing the app publicly. Size the container with the [memory table](/docs/performance#memory-and-hosting).
